hooks.command: if jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(cat|head|tail|less|more|bat) [^ ]*\.env'; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"⛔ 已阻止读取 .env 文件内容，请通过 source .env 加载环境变量，不要直接打印"}'; fi

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; if [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then black "$f" 2>/dev/null && isort "$f" 2>/dev/null; elif [[ "$f" == *.ts || "$f" == *.tsx ]]; then prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; fi; } || true
